map.输入油液颗粒计数器检测结果（每100mL油液中各粒径范围的颗粒数），自动判定 I: Enter particle counts by size range per 100 mL of oil to automatically classify ISO 4406 and NAS 1638 cleanliness codes and suggest suitable applications for each level.
map.ISO 4406 标准采用三个粒径范围（≥4μm/≥6μm/≥14μm）的颗粒数: ISO 4406 uses particle counts in three size ranges (≥4μm/≥6μm/≥14μm) to set the code, e.g. 22/18/13
map.ISO 4406：对 ≥4μm(c)、≥6μm(c)、≥14μm(c) 三档颗粒: ISO 4406: look up codes c4/c6/c14 from particle counts in ≥4μm(c)/≥6μm(c)/≥14μm(c) and output c4/c6/c14; NAS 1638: look up the class per five bands 5-15/15-25/25-50/50-100/>100μm and take the worst (highest) band as the final NAS class
map.油液清洁度按两种标准判定。ISO 4406 采用累加计数：对三个粒径档（≥4μm: Oil cleanliness is judged by two standards. ISO 4406 uses cumulative counting: look up each of three size bands (≥4μm(c)/≥6μm(c)/≥14μm(c)) in a code table (count in an interval gives a code), output as 4/6/14, usually the ≥6μm code sets the application; NAS 1638 looks up five size bands against limit tables and takes the worst (highest) as the system cleanliness class. Lower class is cleaner; servo systems usually need ISO ≤16.
map.NAS 1638 标准采用五个粒径范围（5-15/15-25/25-50/50-: NAS 1638 uses five size ranges (5-15/15-25/25-50/50-100/>100μm) to set the class (NAS 0–12)
map.ISO 4406:1999 采用自动颗粒计数器结果，标注 μm(c) 校准: ISO 4406:1999 uses automatic particle-counter results, calibrated in μm(c)
map.NAS 1638 等级取五个粒径范围中最高等级作为油液清洁度等级: NAS 1638 takes the highest class among the five size ranges as the oil cleanliness class
map.伺服系统要求 ISO 16/14/11 或 NAS 5 级以下；比例阀系统 IS: Servo systems need ISO 16/14/11 or NAS ≤5; proportional-valve systems ISO 18/16/13 or NAS 7
map.一般液压系统 ISO 19/17/14 或 NAS 8 级即可满足要求: General hydraulic systems ISO 19/17/14 or NAS 8 suffice
map.按颗粒计数定 ISO 4406 等级。: Set the ISO 4406 class from particle counts.
map.≥4μm 250000 颗/mL、≥6μm 32000、≥14μm 4000 →: ≥4μm 250000/mL, ≥6μm 32000, ≥14μm 4000 → ISO 4406 code ~21/19/16; fine filtration needed to comply.
map.伺服系统要求 15/13/11，现等级偏高需加 β 滤芯与离线过滤。: Servo needs 15/13/11; current class is high, so add beta-rated elements and offline filtration.
map.三个数分别代表 ≥4/6/14μm 的等级代码（每级约 2 倍颗粒数），越小越干: The three numbers are codes for ≥4/6/14μm (each step ~2× particles); smaller is cleaner.
map.为什么伺服阀要求高？: Why do servo valves demand high cleanliness?
map.伺服阀间隙微米级，颗粒易卡滞磨损，故清洁度要求严。: Servo valve clearances are microns; particles jam and wear, so cleanliness is strict.
map.液压油清洁度等级判定工具，支持 ISO 4406 和 NAS 1638 两大标准: The oil cleanliness classification tool supports ISO 4406 and NAS 1638; enter particle-counter results to auto-classify and check conformance against different hydraulic systems.
